en.name: Kraken
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you would die before Judgment Day, you feign death instead. While feigning death, you can only kill your alive neighbours.

zh.name: 克拉肯
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡。如果你在审判日降临前死亡，改为你假死。你假死时只能杀死与你邻近的存活玩家。
